# Levers

*Generated by `packages/core/scripts/gen-tokens.mjs` from the token language (`packages/core/src/spec`). Never edit by hand:
change the spec and run `pnpm --filter nuikit-core gen:tokens`.*

A lever is a custom property a theme may set (values only, in `.dark {}`); kit.css declares every default once, in the
generated `@layer nk.base` block, and components read only levers. Four tiers, each referencing only the tiers above it:

- **identity**: what a server chooses (palette, faces, scales, shape, type, surfaces, motion, which drawing each family uses). The only tier with literal defaults; those defaults are the premium baseline, so `compileTheme("")` already looks finished.
- **semantic**: roles every component shares (the motion ladder, eases, plate, fill, accent, lines, depth).
- **component** and **part**: `--nk-<component>-<prop>` and `--nk-<component>-<part>-<prop>`; parts are the component's anatomy, its `data-slot` names in render order. A component references only itself, a component it `inherits`, or the tiers above.

**622 levers** (249 identity, 60 semantic, 313 component) · **35 components** · **34 state variables** (set by kit.css rules per state; not levers). Old names: `packages/core/spec/migration.json`, applied by `node packages/core/scripts/migrate-levers.mjs <path>`.

## The language: the core identity

The design language is these **36 choices**. A theme author sets some of them; everything else below is derived from them and
is the reference renderer's business. Another implementation of the language (another framework, another engine) honours these and
the primitives' anatomy, and may emit them under any CSS prefix: the contract is the path (`tokens/nuikit.levers.json`, a W3C Design
Tokens file), not the `--nk-` name nuikit's kit uses. The palette rows are shadcn's own names, so any shadcn or TweakCN theme is a theme.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--background` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Full-screen surfaces (pause, loading, death scrim) |
| `--foreground` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Text on full-screen surfaces |
| `--popover` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Every floating panel |
| `--popover-foreground` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Text in panels |
| `--primary` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | The one main action per surface, the primary face, selection |
| `--primary-foreground` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Text on primary |
| `--muted` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Tracks, slots and wells inside a panel |
| `--muted-foreground` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Secondary text |
| `--destructive` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Danger, damage, low values, death |
| `--border` | color | `stock shadcn neutral` |  | Hairlines |
| `--radius` | length | `0.75rem` |  | The radius scale's base: every radius step derives from it |
| `--brand` | color | `primary if chromatic (OKLCH C ≥ 0.06), else chart-1` |  | The server's signature: active marks, needles, the accent's stops |
| `--hud` | color | `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)` |  | Surfaces drawn straight on the game: HUD chips, hotbar |
| `--font-sans` | font | `Geist, Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |  | Sentences (the body voice) |
| `--font-display` | font | `Geist, Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |  | Anything scanned: keys, titles, labels, captions (the body face unless a theme says otherwise) |
| `--font-mono` | font | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |  | Codes and IDs a player might type |
| `--nk-density` | number | `1` | 0.75–1.3 | Spacing multiplier: 0.75 compact … 1.3 roomy |
| `--nk-shape-skew` | angle | `0deg` | -20–20 | The slant of faces (keys, the primary button, the selection; boxes and text stay upright): 0 = upright, at most ±20deg |
| `--nk-shape-cut` | length | `0px` |  | Chamfered corners (top left, bottom right) as clip-path; 0 = off |
| `--nk-shape-stroke` | length | `1px` |  | Hairline weight of plates, rims and fields |
| `--nk-type-ratio` | number | `1.25` | 1–1.6 | Step between type sizes: 1.125 calm … 1.333 dramatic |
| `--nk-type-case` | keyword | `none` | none uppercase | Anything scanned (keys, titles, labels, captions) in caps or as written |
| `--nk-type-slant` | keyword | `normal` | normal italic | The scanned voices upright or italic (a real italic where the face has one) |
| `--nk-surface-tint` | number | `0` | 0–0.12 | How much brand tints neutral surfaces |
| `--nk-surface-elevation` | keyword | `hard` | none soft deep hard | Shadow recipe: hard is a solid offset drop, no blur |
| `--nk-material-hud-opacity` | number | `0.8` | 0–1 | Opacity of the hud material |
| `--nk-material-menu-opacity` | number | `0.94` | 0–1 | Opacity of the menu material (floor 0.92 for text) |
| `--nk-hud-text` | keyword | `soft` | none soft strong | Shadow under text drawn on the game (semantic depth.text draws it) |
| `--nk-motion-duration` | time | `180ms` | 0–2000 | Base duration d: the ladder is snap 0.5d, fast 0.667d, base d, slow 1.556d, fill 2.333d |
| `--nk-motion-ease` | ease | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` |  | The curve of anything arriving |
| `--nk-motion-feel` | keyword | `crisp` | crisp snap smooth stepped | How it moves: crisp, snap (flash instead of press scale), smooth (longer springs), stepped |
| `--nk-style-fill` | keyword | `solid` | solid soft | Fills, the selection face and levels: solid (flat, vivid) or soft (a tint) |
| `--nk-style-level` | keyword | `liquid` | bar ring liquid slab pips | How a level (0–1) is drawn by vitals, meters, holds |
| `--nk-style-gauge` | keyword | `digital` | arc bar digital | How gauges are drawn |
| `--nk-style-focus` | keyword | `halo` | ring halo tint fill invert bar | Focus on parts that are not rows (rows and buttons light like hover) |
| `--nk-behavior-alert` | number | `0.2` | 0–1 | A level at or under this is an alert (vitals, durability) |

## The language: the text styles

One complete style per role (`packages/core/src/spec/text-styles.ts`), written once into kit.css as `nk-text-<style>`. A style is a
voice (face, slant, weight, tracking, case, overhang pad: `--nk-type-<voice>-*`) at a size and a leading; slant comes only from
the voice, so a component or a screen picks a style and never sets a font-style, family, weight, tracking or case of its own.

| Style | Utility | Voice | Size | Leading | Overrides | For |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| display | `nk-text-display`, `nk-display` | title | `text.display` | `leading.display` | weight type.weight-display, tracking type.tracking-display | Full-screen titles: pause, loading, death |
| section | `nk-text-section` | title | `text.section` | `leading.title` |  | Section and sheet titles |
| title | `nk-text-title`, `nk-title` | title | `text.title` | `leading.title` |  | Panel, dialog and card titles |
| label | `nk-text-label`, `nk-label` | label | `text.label` | `leading.tight` | muted | Labels and meta lines, as written |
| caption | `nk-text-caption`, `nk-caption` | label | `text.label` | `leading.tight` | weight type.weight-strong, tracking type.tracking-label, muted | The short name of a value (Fuel, Balance, Voice): one to three words |
| scan | `nk-text-scan`, `nk-scan` | scan | `text.key` | context |  | Keys, buttons, tabs: anything scanned |
| num | `nk-text-num`, `nk-num` | num | context | context | tabular | Numbers at their context's size: money, counts, timers (tabular) |
| figure | `nk-text-figure` | num | `text.figure` | `leading.figure` | weight type.weight-display, tabular | A number that is the point: a clock, a balance, the speed (tabular, display weight) |
| hud | `nk-text-hud` | num | `text.hud` | `leading.display` | tabular | Values read in motion on the HUD (tabular) |
| body | `nk-text-body`, `nk-body` | body | `text.body` | `leading.normal` |  | Sentences |
| desc | `nk-text-desc` | body | `text.desc` | `leading.normal` | muted | A row's or a notice's description |

## The language: the primitives

A primitive is a DOM contract: its anatomy (the `data-slot` tree in render order), the state variables kit rules set per state, and the
levers it reads. A renderer that emits this anatomy and reads these levers is conformant, whatever it is written in; `nuikit check` reads
the DOM, not the framework. Composites (meters, sheets, notices) are nuikit's own and compose these.

| Primitive | What it is | Anatomy (`data-slot`) | Levers |
|---|---|---|---|
| **screen** | The root of a page: a 16:9 content box centred on any screen, a safe area inside it | `area` → `safe` | 10 |
| **zone** | Nine places and four edges; a zone stacks what it holds towards the screen centre | `item` | 1 |
| **region** | A readable column inside a zone | `body` | 2 |
| **grid** | A grid of cells (inventories, shops) | `cell` | 2 |
| **control** | The Glyph: Kbd, notice icons, telltales, the primary button and the selection | `plate` → `wall` → `face` → `fill` → `legend` → `tag` → `group` → `primary` | 36 |
| **panel** | Every floating surface: menus, inventories, dialogs (the nk-panel utility) | `header` → `icon` → `title` → `description` → `actions` → `body` → `footer` | 22 |
| **row** | The list row (nk-row): generous padding, an icon column, two voices; lit on the control face | `icon` → `title` → `description` → `trail` → `bar` | 11 |
| **list** | A list of selectable items (nk-list, MenuRowList): items a gap apart so a lit selection never touches its neighbour | `item` | 2 |
| **selection** | The one sliding selection per list (nk-indicator, Selection) | `glyph` | 2 |
| **text** | Rich text with inline keys | `key` | 1 |
| **chip** | Always-on HUD chips and squares on the game (nk-chip, nk-hud) | `icon` → `count` | 14 |
| **level** | How a level is drawn under style.level and style.hold (pips, the hold ring, the ink over a solid fill) | `pip` → `hold` → `fill` | 4 |
| **dial** | The dial under gauges and rings: a disc, ticks, a segmented track | `disc` → `ticks` → `track` → `segments` → `segment` → `value` → `needle` → `center` | 1 |
| **slab** | Transient feedback on the game: item, prompt, progress (nk-slab*) | `icon` → `delta` → `key` → `stack` → `line` | 26 |

### font

The four faces every voice picks from.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--font-sans` | font | `Geist, Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |  | Sentences (the body voice) |
| `--font-display` | font | `Geist, Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |  | Anything scanned: keys, titles, labels, captions (the body face unless a theme says otherwise) |
| `--font-numeric` | font | `Geist, Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |  | Every number (always tabular) |
| `--font-mono` | font | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` |  | Codes and IDs a player might type |

### scale

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-scale` | number | `1` | 0.5–2 | UI size multiplier (players scale further, 0.85–1.25) |

### density

Multiplies the spacing scale and the row, chip and slab heights.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-density` | number | `1` | 0.75–1.3 | Spacing multiplier: 0.75 compact … 1.3 roomy |

### space

The spacing scale: one step × density.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-space-1` | length | `var(--nk-space-unit)` |  | 1 × the step |

| `--nk-space-3` | length | `calc(var(--nk-space-unit) * 3)` |  | 3 × the step |
| `--nk-space-4` | length | `calc(var(--nk-space-unit) * 4)` |  | 4 × the step |
| `--nk-space-6` | length | `calc(var(--nk-space-unit) * 6)` |  | 6 × the step |
| `--nk-space-8` | length | `calc(var(--nk-space-unit) * 8)` |  | 8 × the step |
| `--nk-space-unit` | length | `calc(0.25rem * var(--nk-density))` |  | The spacing step |

### radius

Four radius steps from --radius.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |

| `--nk-height-key` | length | `1.5rem` |  | A key / small glyph |

### text

Type sizes from one base × type.ratio.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-text-base` | length | `1rem` |  | Body size; every step derives from it |
| `--nk-text-key` | length | `0.8125rem` |  | The scan voice (keys, buttons, tabs) |
| `--nk-text-body` | length | `var(--nk-text-base)` |  | Sentences |
| `--nk-text-label` | length | `max(0.8125rem, calc(var(--nk-text-base) / var(--nk-type-ratio)))` |  | Labels and captions |

| `--nk-text-section` | length | `calc(var(--nk-text-base) * var(--nk-type-ratio) * var(--nk-type-ratio))` |  | Section and sheet titles |
| `--nk-text-display` | length | `calc(var(--nk-text-base) * var(--nk-type-ratio) * var(--nk-type-ratio) * var(--nk-type-ratio) * var(--nk-type-ratio) * 1.1)` |  | Full-screen titles |
| `--nk-text-figure` | length | `var(--nk-text-display)` |  | A number that is the point (the figure style); a component re-points it for its size |
| `--nk-text-hud` | length | `max(1.125rem, calc(var(--nk-text-base) * var(--nk-type-ratio)))` |  | HUD values read in motion |
| `--nk-text-row` | length | `1.125rem` |  | A row or notice title (the label voice) |
| `--nk-text-desc` | length | `0.875rem` |  | A row or notice description (the body voice) |

| `--nk-line-glow` | length | `1rem` |  | Blur radius of a row's glow (a chip's is 0.75 of it, a meter's 0.625) |

### depth

Shadows the identity's keywords name, in scrim colour.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-depth-elevation` | shadow (derived) | `0 0.25rem 0 0 rgba(var(--scrim-rgb), 0.5)` |  | The box-shadow surface.elevation names (compileTheme writes the recipe) |
| `--nk-depth-text` | shadow (derived) | `0 1px 2px rgba(var(--scrim-rgb), 0.6)` |  | The text-shadow hud.text names (compileTheme writes the recipe) |

### alpha

Each material's effective alpha (day lifts it toward opaque).

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-alpha-day` | number | `0` | 0–1 | 1 while day legibility applies (set by kit.css rules) |
| `--nk-alpha-hud` | number | `calc(var(--nk-material-hud-opacity) + (1 - var(--nk-material-hud-opacity)) * var(--nk-surface-legibility-lift) * var(--nk-alpha-day))` |  | The HUD's alpha |
| `--nk-alpha-menu` | number | `calc(var(--nk-material-menu-opacity) + (1 - var(--nk-material-menu-opacity)) * var(--nk-surface-legibility-lift) * var(--nk-alpha-day))` |  | Menus', sheets' and dialogs' alpha |

### restore

The theme's colours, kept for panels drawn inside an on-game subtree.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-restore-muted-foreground` | color | `var(--muted-foreground)` |  | muted-foreground, as the theme set it |
| `--nk-restore-muted-foreground-rgb` | string | `var(--muted-foreground-rgb)` |  | Its channels |
| `--nk-restore-muted-foreground-a` | string | `var(--muted-foreground-a)` |  | Its alpha |
| `--nk-restore-background` | color | `var(--background)` |  | background, as the theme set it |
| `--nk-restore-background-rgb` | string | `var(--background-rgb)` |  | Its channels |
| `--nk-restore-background-a` | string | `var(--background-a)` |  | Its alpha |

## Components

### screen

The root of a page: a 16:9 content box centred on any screen, a safe area inside it. Anatomy: `area` → `safe`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-screen-ratio` | number | `1.7778` | 1–4 | The content box's width / height (wider screens keep it, centred) |
| `--nk-screen-max` | length | `calc(100vh * var(--nk-screen-ratio))` |  | The content box's width |
| `--nk-screen-edge` | length | `1.5rem` |  | A zone's distance from the safe area (1rem at 4:3, 1.25rem at 16:10) |
| `--nk-screen-scale-min` | number | `0.75` | 0.5–1 | The rem floor as a fraction of the 1080p rem (720p and 4:3 stay readable) |
| `--nk-screen-area-l` | length | `max(0px, calc((100vw - var(--nk-screen-max)) / 2))` |  | The box's left inset from the screen |
| `--nk-screen-area-r` | length | `max(0px, calc((100vw - var(--nk-screen-max)) / 2))` |  | The box's right inset |
| `--nk-screen-area-t` | length | `0px` |  | The box's top inset |
| `--nk-screen-area-b` | length | `0px` |  | The box's bottom inset |
| `--nk-screen-safe-x` | length | `0rem` |  | A safe area inside the box, inline (TV overscan, a bezel) |
| `--nk-screen-safe-y` | length | `0rem` |  | A safe area inside the box, block |

### zone

Nine places and four edges; a zone stacks what it holds towards the screen centre. Anatomy: `item`. Inherits: `screen`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-zone-gap` | length | `var(--nk-space-3)` |  | Between what a zone stacks |

State: `--nk-zone-inset`, `--nk-zone-z`.

### region

A readable column inside a zone. Anatomy: `body`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-region-max` | length | `28rem` |  | Its maximum width |
| `--nk-region-pad` | length | `var(--nk-gap-surface)` |  | Its padding |

### grid

A grid of cells (inventories, shops). Anatomy: `cell`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-grid-cell` | length | `5.5rem` |  | A cell's size |
| `--nk-grid-gap` | length | `var(--nk-space-2)` |  | Between cells |

State: `--nk-grid-cols`.

### control

The Glyph: Kbd, notice icons, telltales, the primary button and the selection. Anatomy: `plate` → `wall` → `face` → `fill` → `legend` → `tag` → `group` → `primary`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-control-plate-color` | color | `var(--border)` |  | The solid plate behind the face |
| `--nk-control-plate-dim` | color | `var(--nk-control-plate-color)` |  | The plate on the HUD |
| `--nk-control-plate-x` | length | `0px` |  | How far the plate sits right of the face (0 = none) |
| `--nk-control-plate-y` | length | `0px` |  | How far the plate sits below the face (0 = none) |
| `--nk-control-plate-press` | length | `1px` |  | How far a held glyph presses toward its plate |
| `--nk-control-wall-height` | length | `0rem` |  | How far the face sits above its wall (0 = flat; the primary button, the selection) |
| `--nk-control-wall-shade` | number | `0.45` | 0–1 | How dark the wall is (the scrim over the face colour) |
| `--nk-control-face-color` | color | `var(--muted)` |  | The face |
| `--nk-control-face-ink` | color | `var(--popover-foreground)` |  | The legend's colour on the face |
| `--nk-control-face-light` | color | `rgba(var(--popover-foreground-rgb), 0)` |  | The face's top hairline (transparent = flat) |
| `--nk-control-face-shade` | color | `rgba(var(--scrim-rgb), 0)` |  | The face's bottom inner shade |
| `--nk-control-face-rim` | color | `rgba(var(--foreground-rgb), 0.32)` |  | The face's rim |
| `--nk-control-face-rim-focus` | color | `rgba(var(--foreground-rgb), 0.4)` |  | The rim while lit |
| `--nk-control-face-radius` | length | `var(--nk-radius-key)` |  | The face's radius |
| `--nk-control-face-skew` | angle | `var(--nk-shape-skew)` |  | The face's slant (the box stays upright) |
| `--nk-control-face-shadow` | shadow | `inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--nk-control-face-shade), inset 0 1px 0 0 var(--nk-control-face-light)` |  | The face's inner light and shade |
| `--nk-control-face-clip` | string | `var(--nk-line-clip-sm)` |  | The face's clip-path (the chamfer) |
| `--nk-control-face-confirm` | color | `var(--foreground)` |  | The face when confirmed |
| `--nk-control-face-confirm-ink` | color | `var(--background)` |  | The legend when confirmed |
| `--nk-control-face-active` | paint | `var(--nk-accent-paint)` |  | The face of an active glyph (the mic while talking, N on the compass, a checked box) |
| `--nk-control-legend-font` | font | `var(--nk-type-scan-family)` |  | The legend's face |
| `--nk-control-legend-weight` | number | `var(--nk-type-scan-weight)` | 100–900 | The legend's weight |
| `--nk-control-legend-pad` | length | `calc(var(--nk-type-scan-pad) / 2)` |  | The italic overhang split to both sides |
| `--nk-control-legend-shift` | length | `0em` |  | A nudge for a leaning face |
| `--nk-control-legend-gap` | length | `var(--nk-space-1)` |  | Between a glyph's characters |
| `--nk-control-legend-inset` | length | `var(--nk-space-1)` |  | The legend's inline padding |
| `--nk-control-tag-delay` | time | `80ms` |  | The tag opens this long after the glyph lands |
| `--nk-control-primary-color` | color | `var(--primary)` |  | The primary face under style.fill solid (the primary button, the lit row, the active tab) |
| `--nk-control-primary-ink` | color | `var(--primary-foreground)` |  | Text on the primary face |
| `--nk-control-primary-rim` | color | `transparent` |  | The primary face's rim (transparent = none) |
| `--nk-control-primary-radius` | length | `var(--nk-radius-control)` |  | The primary face's radius |
| `--nk-control-primary-tint` | number | `0.16` | 0–1 | The face's opacity under style.fill soft |
| `--nk-control-primary-inset` | length | `0.375rem` |  | How far the selection sits in from its item's sides (room for the skew) |
| `--nk-control-primary-lift` | length | `1px` |  | How far the face rises on hover and focus |
| `--nk-control-primary-press` | number | `0.67` | 0–1.5 | How far a pressed primary sinks, as a fraction of its wall |
| `--nk-control-primary-overhang` | length | `0.25rem` |  | How far a row's selection reaches past its text |

State: `--nk-control-now-face`, `--nk-control-now-ink`, `--nk-control-now-rim`, `--nk-control-now-plate`, `--nk-control-x`, `--nk-control-y`, `--nk-control-sel-face`, `--nk-control-sel-wall`, `--nk-control-sel-shade`, `--nk-control-sel-ink`, `--nk-control-sel-rim`, `--nk-control-sel-shape`, `--nk-control-host-radius`, `--nk-control-host-clip`, `--nk-control-tone`.

### panel

Every floating surface: menus, inventories, dialogs (the nk-panel utility). Anatomy: `header` → `icon` → `title` → `description` → `actions` → `body` → `footer`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-panel-bg` | color | `rgba(var(--surface-rgb), calc(var(--surface-a) * var(--nk-alpha-menu)))` |  | The panel's fill: the surface at the menu material's alpha |
| `--nk-panel-fg` | color | `var(--popover-foreground)` |  | Text in the panel |
| `--nk-panel-border` | color | `var(--nk-plate-hair)` |  | The panel's hairline |
| `--nk-panel-radius` | length | `var(--nk-radius-surface)` |  | The panel's radius |
| `--nk-panel-blur` | length | `var(--nk-material-menu-blur)` |  | Backdrop blur (with surface.backdrop on) |
| `--nk-panel-cut` | length | `var(--nk-shape-cut)` |  | The chamfer's size |
| `--nk-panel-clip` | string | `var(--nk-line-clip)` |  | The panel's clip-path |
| `--nk-panel-gradient` | string | `linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(var(--popover-foreground-rgb), var(--nk-surface-gradient)), rgba(var(--popover-foreground-rgb), 0) 60%)` |  | The light falloff |
| `--nk-panel-edge` | shadow | `inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(var(--popover-foreground-rgb), var(--nk-material-menu-edge))` |  | The machined top edge |
| `--nk-panel-shadow` | shadow | `var(--nk-depth-elevation)` |  | The panel's drop: the elevation recipe |
| `--nk-panel-divider` | string | `var(--nk-line-width) solid var(--nk-panel-border)` |  | The one hairline under a header |
| `--nk-panel-width` | length | `20rem` |  | Width (md) |
| `--nk-panel-width-sm` | length | `18rem` |  | Width (sm) |
| `--nk-panel-width-lg` | length | `24rem` |  | Width (lg) |
| `--nk-panel-header-height` | length | `calc(3.25rem * var(--nk-density))` |  | A header's minimum height |
| `--nk-panel-header-padding` | string | `var(--nk-gap-surface) var(--nk-gap-surface) var(--nk-space-4)` |  | Surface padding; the title a step off its hairline |
| `--nk-panel-body-padding` | string | `var(--nk-space-3)` |  | The body's padding |
| `--nk-panel-footer-padding` | string | `var(--nk-space-4) var(--nk-gap-surface) var(--nk-gap-surface)` |  | On the panel itself, no rule above it |
| `--nk-panel-footer-rule` | string | `none` |  | A rule above the footer (none: spacing separates it) |
| `--nk-panel-actions-bracket` | length | `0px` |  | L-shaped corner marks (0 = off) |
| `--nk-panel-actions-bracket-width` | length | `calc(var(--nk-line-width) * 2)` |  | The marks' weight |
| `--nk-panel-actions-bracket-color` | color | `var(--brand)` |  | The marks' colour |

State: `--nk-panel-backdrop`.

### row

The list row (nk-row): generous padding, an icon column, two voices; lit on the control face. Anatomy: `icon` → `title` → `description` → `trail` → `bar`. Inherits: `control`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-row-height` | length | `var(--nk-height-row)` |  | A single-line row's minimum height |
| `--nk-row-radius` | length | `var(--nk-radius-control)` |  | The row's radius |
| `--nk-row-clip` | string | `var(--nk-line-clip-sm)` |  | The row's clip-path |
| `--nk-row-pad-y` | length | `var(--nk-space-2)` |  | Block padding |
| `--nk-row-pad-x` | length | `var(--nk-space-3)` |  | Inline padding |
| `--nk-row-padding` | string | `var(--nk-row-pad-y) var(--nk-row-pad-x)` |  | Both paddings |
| `--nk-row-gap` | length | `var(--nk-space-4)` |  | Between the icon, the text and the trail |
| `--nk-row-font-size` | length | `var(--nk-text-base)` |  | The row's text size |
| `--nk-row-accent` | color | `var(--brand)` |  | The colour that marks the active row or slot (an outline, a hold ring) |
| `--nk-row-icon-box` | length | `2rem` |  | The icon box beside the title (the icon inside is icon.md) |
| `--nk-row-bar-width` | length | `0.1875rem` |  | The focus bar's width (style.focus: bar) |

### list

A list of selectable items (nk-list, MenuRowList): items a gap apart so a lit selection never touches its neighbour. Anatomy: `item`. Inherits: `control`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-list-gap` | length | `calc(var(--nk-control-wall-height) + var(--nk-space-1))` |  | Between items: the wall plus breathing room |
| `--nk-list-pad-x` | length | `calc(var(--nk-control-primary-inset) + var(--nk-control-primary-overhang))` |  | Inline padding: room for the selection's inset and skew |

### menu-row

A menu row: icon or image, title and description, progress, meta, a stepper or value, actions. Anatomy: `image` → `icon` → `body` → `title` → `description` → `progress` → `meta` → `stepper` → `value` → `actions` → `chevron` → `details` → `list`. Inherits: `row`, `control`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-menu-row-gap` | length | `var(--nk-space-1)` |  | Between a trail's controls |
| `--nk-menu-row-image-size` | length | `2rem` |  | An image's box |
| `--nk-menu-row-progress-height` | length | `0.25rem` |  | The progress bar's height |
| `--nk-menu-row-details-width` | length | `16rem` |  | The details flyout's width |
| `--nk-menu-row-value-width` | length | `3rem` |  | The value column's minimum width |

### selection

The one sliding selection per list (nk-indicator, Selection). Anatomy: `glyph`. Inherits: `control`.

| Lever | Type | Default | Range / values | What it moves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--nk-selection-time` | time | `var(--nk-time-base)` |  | How long the selection glides |
| `--nk-selection-ease` | string | `var(--nk-ease-move)` |  | The glide's curve |
